name: Snoezelen Deep Sea Desk
summary:
1.Pop the floating bubbles using your finger.
2.Look at the dolphin in front of you and touch it when the floating dolphin becomes the same color.
3.Follow the instructions, focus on the seashell, and listen to the sound of the waves.
4.Look at the color of the floating whale and select the seashell with the matching color.
5.Respond appropriately when an unexpected situation occurs.
